errors.text_span: The performance increases with each additional SFT dataset across all model sizes.
errors.evidence: This statement is an incorrect generalization. The chart shows that for both the LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B models, the performance decreases slightly when moving from the 'SFT on D₀, D₁' dataset to the 'SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' dataset.
The bar for LLaMA-2-7B with 'SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂' reaches approximately 83%, not 85%. The value 85% is higher than any bar in the chart.
For the LLaMA-2-13B model, the scores do not end at 82%. The peak value for this group is approximately 83% ('+ SFT on D₀, D₁') and the final value is approximately 80% ('+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂').
For the LLaMA-2-70B model, the starting score for 'no SFT' is approximately 81%, not 75%.

errors.text_span: with the largest model and full SFT dataset achieving the highest score
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The highest score in the chart (approx. 84%) is achieved by the LLaMA-2-70B model with the '+ SFT on D₀, D₁' dataset, not the 'full SFT dataset' ('+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂'), which scores lower at approx. 83%.
